class TestComputeSignalOverlap:
    """Tests for compute_signal_overlap (Layer 1 — Detection, pure)."""

    def test_hp_overlap_identical(self):
        """Identical non-empty sets → 1.0."""
        result = compute_signal_overlap(["s1", "s2", "s3"], ["s1", "s2", "s3"])
        assert result == 1.0, f"Expected 1.0 for identical sets, got {result}"

    def test_hp_overlap_partial(self):
        """Partial overlap → correct Jaccard."""
        # Intersection = {s2, s3} (2), Union = {s1, s2, s3, s4} (4) → 0.5
        result = compute_signal_overlap(["s1", "s2", "s3"], ["s2", "s3", "s4"])
        assert result == pytest.approx(0.5), f"Expected 0.5 Jaccard, got {result}"

    def test_edge_overlap_both_empty(self):
        """Both empty → 0.0."""
        result = compute_signal_overlap([], [])
        assert result == 0.0, f"Expected 0.0 for both empty, got {result}"

    def test_edge_overlap_one_empty(self):
        """One empty, one non-empty → 0.0."""
        result = compute_signal_overlap(["s1"], [])
        assert result == 0.0, f"Expected 0.0 when one set is empty, got {result}"

    def test_edge_overlap_disjoint(self):
        """Disjoint sets → 0.0."""
        result = compute_signal_overlap(["s1", "s2"], ["s3", "s4"])
        assert result == 0.0, f"Expected 0.0 for disjoint sets, got {result}"

    def test_inv_overlap_symmetric(self):
        """Overlap is symmetric: f(a, b) == f(b, a)."""
        a, b = ["s1", "s2", "s3"], ["s2", "s3", "s4", "s5"]
        result_ab = compute_signal_overlap(a, b)
        result_ba = compute_signal_overlap(b, a)
        assert result_ab == pytest.approx(result_ba), (
            f"Symmetry violated: f(a,b)={result_ab} != f(b,a)={result_ba}"
        )

    def test_overlap_result_range(self):
        """Result is always in [0.0, 1.0]."""
        result = compute_signal_overlap(["s1", "s2"], ["s2", "s3", "s4"])
        assert 0.0 <= result <= 1.0, f"Result {result} out of [0.0, 1.0]"

    def test_overlap_subset(self):
        """When A ⊂ B, Jaccard = |A| / |B|."""
        result = compute_signal_overlap(["s1", "s2"], ["s1", "s2", "s3", "s4"])
        assert result == pytest.approx(2.0 / 4.0), f"Expected 0.5 for subset, got {result}"
